scope: The main Boljoon Church and its attached convent, with an approximate north belfry, in the November 2021 documented configuration. Includes the pedimented east front, buttressed coral-stone nave, metal nave roof and tiled convent. The detached El Gran Baluarte, school, cemetery and interiors are separate.
